name: Waltz Cresswell
source:
"Adults aren't like children. They worry too much and don't appreciate the small joys in life. As we grow up, we forget how to be happy."

A street magician that is more than what he seems. Waltz is sincere, kind and mature beyond his age. He is a firm believer in magic, smiles and laughter.

Currently takes on a childish appearance. Though his physical form appears much younger, he still retains his maturity.
